_notes: Phase 1 English source. Flat key→string map for Valheaven menu UI. Parameterized messages use {0}-style placeholders.
chrome.require_world: Enter a world to use these controls.
chrome.validation.integer_range: {0} must be a whole number between {1} and {2}.
search.help: Search tabs and features. Press Enter or click Go to jump to the first match.
search.go.help: Jump to the first matching tab or feature.
toast.search.empty: Enter a feature or tab name to search.
settings.controls.note: Menu open key. Feature hotkeys are under the Hotkeys tab.
settings.change_key.help: Click, then press the new menu key. Escape cancels.
settings.language.note: Auto follows Valheim's language when supported. Export locales to share JSON with translators.
settings.menu_scale.help: Changes menu size after you release the slider.
settings.tooltips.help: Shows a short description when you rest the pointer on a control.
settings.window_position.help: Centers the menu on the screen.
settings.block_inputs.help: While on, Valheim ignores your keyboard and mouse while the menu is open. If turned off, you can walk around and play while the menu stays open as an overlay.
settings.save_on_close.help: Saves your settings when you close the menu.
settings.remember_character.help: Restores your saved abilities when you enter a world.
settings.current_settings.help: Saves menu, ESP, and feature settings.
settings.saved_settings.help: Replaces current settings with your last save. Character toggles restore only when Remember character toggles is on.
settings.defaults.warning: Resets menu preferences and returns the open key to F8. World and character changes are kept.
settings.cheat_flag.warning: Also runs automatically when you spawn. Clears this character's saved cheat flag and any cheated-item marks in inventory. Does not change world modifiers.
character.god_mode.help: Blocks all damage and keeps health full while enabled.
character.one_hit_creatures.help: Your attacks defeat creatures in one hit. Separate from structures.
character.one_hit_structures.help: Your hits destroy buildings and other structures in one hit. Separate from creatures.
character.outgoing_damage.help: Multiplies damage you deal. 1 is vanilla. Stacks with One-hit kill (one-hit still wins).
character.incoming_damage.help: Multiplies damage you take. 0 blocks damage types that still reach ApplyDamage; God mode still fully blocks. Local player only.
character.hit_push.help: Multiplies knockback / push force on your hits. 1 is vanilla.
character.stagger_protection.help: Blocks stagger buildup and stagger state on your character.
character.unlimited_stamina.help: Keeps stamina full and blocks stamina drain.
character.unlimited_eitr.help: Keeps eitr full and blocks eitr drain.
character.instant_mining.help: Breaks ore, trees, and logs in one hit. Ignores hard-tree gates.
character.draw_bow_immediate.help: Bows reach full draw as soon as you start drawing. Release to fire.
character.preserve_ammo.help: Attacks do not consume ammo or fishing bait (UseAmmo). You still need at least one matching item equipped or in inventory. Covers bows, crossbows, and other ammo types.
character.projectile_speed.help: Multiplies your local projectile velocity (arrows, bolts, spears, magic). 1 is vanilla. Applied after aim assist / magic bullet so direction stays correct.
character.multishot.help: Fires multiple projectiles per shot. Hits raise skill; extra shots drain durability unless Unlimited durability is on.
character.arrow_count.help: Projectiles spawned per ranged attack when Multishot is on.
character.arrow_spread.help: Extra aim cone in degrees added to each multishot volley.
character.melee_multi_hit.help: Repeats the melee swing resolution. Each repeat raises skill and drains durability unless Unlimited durability is on.
character.melee_hits.help: How many times one melee swing resolves when Melee multi-hit is on.
character.pierce_shots.help: Your projectiles keep going through creatures and only stop on terrain. Local shots only.
character.bow_aim_assist.help: While drawing or firing a bow/crossbow/spear, steers aim toward a target in your cone. While on, prediction and local projectiles use zero gravity so aim matches the shot. Local player only.
character.show_aim_predict.help: When Bow aim assist is on, draws a lightweight marker at the predicted lead / impact point.
character.no_arrow_gravity.help: Sets gravity to 0 on your local bow, crossbow, and spear projectiles. Also used without aim assist. Prefer this if you want flat arrows while assist is off.
character.magic_bullet.help: On fire, redirects your projectile velocity toward the predicted target. Stronger than aim assist; still local-only and separate from Pierce shots.
character.aim_strength.help: How hard Bow aim assist blends toward the predicted aim. Magic bullet always fully redirects.
character.aim_cone.help: Max degrees from crosshair to pick a target. Magic bullet uses a slightly wider cone.
character.aim_range.help: Max target distance for aim assist and magic bullet.
character.aim_at_players.help: Allow bow aim assist / magic bullet to lock onto other players. Off by default for PvE.
character.melee_cleave.help: Melee swings use the game multi-hit path so one swing can hit several targets.
character.cleave_angle.help: Extra degrees added to the melee hit cone when Melee cleave is on.
character.auto_parry.help: While you hold block, timing stays in the perfect-block window.
character.perfect_block_window.help: Multiplies the perfect-block timing window. 1 is vanilla.
character.no_special_cooldown.help: Secondary / special attacks are ready immediately.
character.no_tool_delay.help: Removes swing delay between tool and weapon uses.
character.unlimited_bait.help: Casting does not consume bait. You still need at least one bait. Infinite arrows also covers bait.
character.attract_fish.help: Nearby fish take interest in your float much more reliably.
character.always_bite.help: Any interested fish nibbles successfully, even with the wrong bait.
character.instant_hook.help: A successful nibble hooks the fish immediately.
character.instant_reel.help: Hooked fish are reeled in and caught automatically.
character.no_fish_escape.help: Hooked fish do not thrash-escape, and their stamina drain is removed.
character.unbreakable_line.help: Your fishing line will not snap from distance while you own the float.
character.skill_xp_mult.help: 1 is vanilla. Higher multiplies skill XP. At 25, each XP gain grants a full level (old Fast training).
character.new_level.help: An exact level from 0 to 100. Decimals are accepted.
character.apply_selected_skill.help: Raises or lowers the skill to the entered level.
character.apply_all_skills.warning: Sets every skill on this character to the entered level.
character.always_near_fire.help: Counts as standing by a fire for comfort and rest.
character.lock_rested.help: Keeps the Rested status effect active and refreshes its timer. Works with Always near fire.
character.no_fall_damage.help: Blocks fall HitType damage on your character.
character.noclip.help: Disables your solid colliders so you pass through terrain and pieces. Distinct from Flight - combine both to move freely through the world. Restores colliders when off. Local only.
character.noclip.movement_help: Pass through colliders (same toggle as Survival). Pair with Flight to move through the world freely.
character.keep_inventory.help: Skips tombstone creation so your inventory stays with you.
character.keep_food_on_death.help: Restores active food slots after death. Pair with Keep inventory / Prevent skill loss.
character.no_bed_restrictions.help: Ignores fire and exposure checks when claiming a bed.
character.owned_tombstone.help: Teleports to your nearest loaded owned tombstone.
character.nearby_tombstone.help: Interacts / pulls inventory from your nearby owned tombstone.
character.prevent_skill_loss.help: Blocks skill drain on death (OnDeath / LowerAllSkills). Does not freeze XP gains.
character.freeze_skills.help: Blocks skill loss and XP gains (RaiseSkill + death drain). Use Freeze XP alone if you only want no gains.
character.freeze_xp.help: Blocks RaiseSkill XP only. Skill loss on death still happens unless Prevent skill loss or Freeze skills is on.
character.status_apply.help: Applies the chosen status effect to you.
character.status_remove.help: Removes that effect if it is active on you.
character.status_clear_all.warning: Removes every status effect currently on your character.
character.inf_food.help: Keeps active food slots at full duration.
character.inf_food_buff.help: Refreshes food buff duration while enabled.
character.no_food_decay.help: Prevents food timers from ticking down.
character.always_can_eat.help: Lets you eat even when food slots are occupied.
character.no_food_cooldown.help: Removes the delay before eating the same food again.
character.food_eat.help: Eats from your inventory if you have it, otherwise adds one copy then eats.
character.food.note: Cooking / fermenter / smelter timers are under Build > Stations. Plant growth and breeding are under Farming.
character.flight.help: Fly with movement keys. Jump rises; crouch descends.
character.super_jump.help: Increases jump strength. Works with infinite jumps.
character.infinite_jumps.help: Jump repeatedly without touching the ground.
character.walk_speed.help: Multiplies normal jog and walk-toggle speed. 1 is vanilla. Local player only; skipped while debug flying.
character.run_speed.help: Multiplies sprint / run speed. 1 is vanilla.
character.sneak_speed.help: Multiplies crouch / sneak speed. 1 is vanilla.
character.speed_reset.help: Resets walk, run, swim, and sneak multipliers to 1.
character.no_water_stamina.help: Avoids wet and related water stamina penalties.
character.sit_mount_anywhere.help: Enables sit-anywhere emote and nearest-saddle mount helpers when APIs allow.
character.sit_emote.help: Starts the sit emote without a chair.
character.mount_nearest.help: Tries to mount the closest Sadle within 40 m.
character.boat_boost.help: Multiplies sail and paddle thrust on the ship you helm. Restored each physics step when you leave the wheel.
character.boat_speed_mult.help: How hard the boat boost pushes. 1 is vanilla.
character.boat_stable.help: Extra damping so ships tip and rock less while you helm.
character.boat_fly.help: While you helm: Jump up / crouch down, plus full sail/paddle forward-back and rudder turn in the air (drives rigidbody when above water disableLevel). Jump does not leave the wheel. Restores gravity when you leave the wheel or turn this off. Local helm only.
character.force_wind.help: Locks wind to your facing direction so sails catch a following breeze.
character.boat_inf_health.help: Keeps the ship you are helming from taking structure damage.
character.easy_cart.help: Lightens an attached cart and strengthens the hitch while you pull.
character.cart_ease.help: Higher = lighter cart / stronger hitch. Only while Easy cart is on.
character.cart_inf_health.help: Keeps the cart you are hauling from taking structure damage.
character.guardian_equip.help: Equips the chosen power and clears its cooldown.
character.instant_guardian_cd.help: Keeps guardian power cooldown at zero.
character.hold_guardian.help: Reapplies the equipped power until this toggle is turned off.
build.free_building.help: Place building pieces without spending materials.
build.ignore_unstable.help: Allows placement when support would be unstable.
build.ignore_player_block.help: Places even if a player occupies the ghost.
build.allow_overlap.help: Clears placement ghost blocks so pieces can overlap each other / invalid space checks. Complements Ignore player in the way.
build.ignore_mystical.help: Bypasses area forces that block building.
build.extended_distance.help: Multiplies max place distance while building.
build.distance_mult.help: How far you can place when Extended build distance is on. 1 is vanilla.
build.fine_rotation.help: Uses 1-degree place rotation steps instead of the coarse vanilla angle.
build.workbench_no_roof.help: Uses workbenches that are not covered.
build.station_level_10.help: Treats nearby crafting stations as level 10.
build.free_craft.help: Craft and upgrade without materials (including Forge of Potential idols). Does not discover recipes - use Unlock below for that.
build.craft_from_chests.help: When Free crafting is off, HaveRequirements and material consumption also use accessible nearby containers you own/can open. Host/co-op: only chests this client can claim. Free crafting already skips costs.
build.chest_craft_range.help: Radius for craft-from-chests material checks and consumption. Typical station range is ~10-20 m.
build.instant_crafting.help: Skips the crafting and upgrade timer.
build.unlock_recipes.warning: Writes all recipes, materials, stations, and build pieces to this character. Separate from Free crafting. Re-open craft UI or stand at a station to see them.
build.forge_never_break.help: Removes break chance. Without Always succeed, a failed roll can still drop a refinement level.
build.indestructible.help: Blocks hit and environmental wear damage on structures.
build.radius.help: Range for repair and destroy actions.
build.destroy_nearby.warning: Permanently destroys structures within the radius. There is no undo.
build.inf_station_fuel.help: Keeps smelter, kiln, and fireplace fuel topped up.
build.fireplace_no_wet.help: Prevents fireplaces from being extinguished by wetness where supported.
build.station_slots.help: Keeps smelter and kiln queues filled.
build.station_always_on.help: Keeps owned smelters processing while enabled.
build.production.note: Speeds owned cooking stations, fermenters, and smelters. Instant plant growth lives under Farming. Pair with Character > Food for eat-from-menu.
build.production_speed.help: Divides cook / ferment / smelt / grow times on stations you own. 1 is vanilla.
build.instant_cook.help: Owned cooking stations finish almost immediately.
build.instant_smelt.help: Owned smelters / kilns finish almost immediately.
build.stations.plant_note: Plant tools (instant grow, force grow, tame, breed) are under the Farming tab.
build.carry_mult.help: Multiplies your max carry weight. 1 is vanilla.
build.no_encumber.help: Never encumbered; auto-pickup keeps working when overweight.
build.item_magnet.help: Pulls nearby ground items toward you.
build.stack_pickup_mult.help: Multiplies stack size when picking up ground loot, capped by max stack.
build.inf_stack_split.help: When you split or drag part of a stack, the source stack keeps its count (duplicate).
build.inventory.note: Set player rows/columns, then Apply. Chest bonus rows apply when you open a chest. Stack multiplier/override changes how high items stack. Lowering size may drop items that no longer fit.
build.player_rows.help: Vanilla is 4; store upgrades go to 9. Valheaven allows up to 12. Press Apply after changing.
build.player_extra_cols.help: Adds columns beyond the normal width of 8. Press Apply after changing.
build.chest_bonus_rows.help: Extra rows added to chests when you open them. Chest width stays normal.
build.stack_mult.help: Multiplies max stack size for stackable items. 1 is vanilla. Applies immediately.
build.stack_override.help: When above 0, all stackables use this max instead of the multiplier. 0 = off.
build.capacity_apply.help: Applies bag size now and refreshes stack caps. {0}
build.extended_reach.help: Use the reach distance set below.
build.chests.note: Moves stacks between your inventory and chests you can open in range. Prefers existing stacks, then empty slots. Skips private or ward-blocked chests.
build.deposit_materials_only.help: When depositing, only move materials (wood, ore, etc.).
build.deposit_skip_equipped.help: Leaves currently equipped gear in your inventory.
build.withdraw_filter.help: Optional. Withdraw only items whose name contains this text. Empty = all.
build.deposit_chests.help: Moves inventory stacks into nearby accessible chests.
build.withdraw_chests.help: Pulls stacks from nearby accessible chests into your inventory.
build.sort_inventory.help: Sorts by type/name and merges compatible stacks.
build.sort_chests.help: Sorts and merges stacks in accessible nearby chests.
build.deposit_junk.help: Deposits default junk list plus your extras, minus blacklist.
build.junk_extras.help: Extra item names treated as junk (comma-separated).
build.junk_blacklist.help: Names removed from the junk set.
build.auto_pickup_filter.help: When on, ground auto-pickup and magnet honor whitelist/blacklist.
build.pickup_whitelist.help: If non-empty, only these items auto-pickup. Comma-separated.
build.pickup_blacklist.help: These items never auto-pickup when filter is on.
build.copy.note: 1) Set A/B corners (or Fit to location). 2) Optional Grow. 3) Copy. 4) Preview, then Confirm. Cyan box = volume. With World structures on, ruins and houses in the volume are included. Large copies can hitch.
build.copy_use_feet.help: When on, corners use your feet instead of the look-hit. Useful for flat pads.
build.include_world_structures.help: When on, copy includes world ruins, houses, and arenas in the volume - not only your own builds. Large copies can lag; paste may need host ownership.
build.corner_a.help: Sets the first corner. Looking at a piece snaps to that structure.
build.corner_b.help: Sets the second corner. Together with A this defines the copy box.
build.corners_clear.help: Clears Corner A and Corner B.
build.fit_location.help: Snaps A-B to the location under the crosshair (or nearest within 40 m) and turns on world structures. Huge areas can be thousands of pieces.
build.grow_selection.help: Expands A-B until overlapping structures in the volume are enclosed.
build.copy_volume.help: Copies buildable pieces in the A-B box. Cap {0}. Large copies are heavy; paste may need host ownership.
build.preview_feet.help: Shows transparent blue ghosts at your feet. Adjust height/yaw/nudge, then Confirm.
build.preview_crosshair.help: Shows transparent blue ghosts at the look-hit. Adjust, then Confirm.
build.paste_height.help: Vertical offset for the active paste preview.
build.paste_yaw.help: Yaw rotation of the paste preview.
build.paste_nudge_x.help: Horizontal nudge left/right in preview space.
build.paste_nudge_z.help: Horizontal nudge forward/back in preview space.
build.confirm_paste.help: Places the clipboard at the preview position.
build.cancel_preview.help: Clears the paste ghost without placing.
build.blueprints.note: Saved across worlds and characters. Export a .vbp file to share a full build (pieces included).
build.blueprint_name.help: Name used when saving or renaming.
build.save_blueprint.help: Saves the current clipboard into your blueprint library.
build.blueprint_load.help: Loads the blueprint into the clipboard. Then use Paste preview or Confirm.
build.blueprint_paste_feet.help: Loads the blueprint and pastes at your feet (no preview).
build.blueprint_rename.help: Renames the selected blueprint to the name field above.
build.blueprint_delete.warning: Removes this blueprint from your library.
build.blueprint_export.help: Writes a shareable blueprints/<name>.vbp file with all pieces.
build.blueprint_import_path.help: File name under blueprints/, or a full path to a .vbp.
build.blueprint_import.help: Adds the file to your library. Same names overwrite.
build.piece_scale.help: Target scale for the look-at piece (0.25-4x).
build.apply_scale.help: Scales the piece under the crosshair (you must own it).
build.repair_hammer.help: While holding a hammer, periodically repairs nearby structures.
world.always_day.help: Holds daylight at noon on this machine. World clock still advances. Turn off before weather that needs night lighting. Cleared automatically when you apply weather.
world.pickaxe_radius.help: Multiplies melee attack range for mining swings.
world.weather.note: Host only. Applies on this machine; other players keep their own weather. Force following wind is under Character > Movement.
world.weather_duration.help: 0 keeps the weather until Clear. Otherwise clears after this many real-time seconds.
world.weather_instant.help: Switches weather immediately instead of blending.
world.apply_weather.help: Applies the selected weather. Turns off Always daytime so lighting matches.
world.reveal_map.warning: Permanently reveals this world's map for your character. Previous exploration cannot be restored.
world.display_name.help: Name displayed beside your chat message.
world.announce.help: Shows the message in yellow at the center of the screen.
world.chat.help: Sends the message with the entered display name.
world.creatures.radius.help: Range for nearby creature and cleanup actions.
world.freeze_ai_nearby.help: Pauses BaseAI updates for untamed creatures within the radius. Does not retame. Local session.
world.freeze_ai_global.help: Pauses BaseAI for all loaded untamed creatures on this client. Stronger than nearby.
world.remove_drops.warning: Permanently deletes loose items within the radius.
world.remove_tombstones.warning: Deletes your nearby tombstones and all items inside them.
world.kill_creatures.warning: Kills creatures within the radius, including tamed animals.
world.brush_radius.help: Size of the terrain brush. Large radii only affect loaded heightmaps you own.
world.brush_amount.help: Raise/lower delta. Precision mode applies 25% of this value.
world.paint_strength.help: How strongly paint layers are applied.
world.square_brush.help: Switches from a circular brush to a square brush.
world.precision.help: Applies 25% of the height adjustment and softer raise edges for fine work.
world.brush_at_look.help: Centers the brush on the surface under the crosshair instead of your feet (still uses player Y for Flatten to player height).
world.preset_wide.help: Radius 40 m, amount 2 m. Use carefully near builds.
world.flatten.warning: Levels terrain in the brush to the brush-center height (feet or look hit).
world.flatten_player.warning: Levels the brush area (feet or look XZ) to your feet height - good for pads.
world.raise.warning: Raises terrain in the brush. Buildings can be affected.
world.lower.warning: Lowers terrain in the brush. Buildings can be affected.
world.smooth.warning: Smooths height differences in the brush.
world.fill.warning: Levels toward brush height while softly raising dips - useful for hole fill.
world.reset_terrain.warning: Removes height and paint changes inside the brush (and nearby player terrain modifiers).
world.paint_apply.warning: Applies the selected ground paint in the brush. Persists in the world save.
world.undo.help: Restores height/paint arrays from before the last Valheaven terrain action. One step only.
world.terrain.note: Terrain edits need ownership of loaded compilers (singleplayer / host). Undo is session-only and replaces the previous snapshot each stroke.
teleport.crosshair.help: Raycasts from the camera and teleports to the hit point (or a short distance ahead if nothing is hit).
teleport.tp_to_ping.help: When you send a map ping (Chat.SendPing), teleport there. Local player only.
teleport.disable_portal_fade.help: While teleporting, forces Hud loading-screen alpha to 0 so the world stays visible. Best-effort; some fade paths may still flash.
teleport.copy_position.help: Copies your position into the coordinate fields.
teleport.move_coords.help: Moves to the entered coordinates. Check the altitude before teleporting.
teleport.move_marker.help: Teleports to the chosen map marker.
teleport.bookmarks.note: Saved per world in Valheaven.bookmarks.json beside the game (or AppData fallback).
teleport.bookmark_name.help: Name for the bookmark at your current position.
teleport.save_bookmark.help: Creates or updates a bookmark for this world.
teleport.bookmark_delete.warning: Removes the bookmark from this world's list.
teleport.travel_player.help: Teleports you to the selected player's current map position.
teleport.player_required: Choose a player sharing their map position.
teleport.nearest_location.help: Finds the nearest generated location. Search for an altar, trader, or forge by its location name.
teleport.forge_of_potential.help: Finds the nearest Forge of Potential (refinement station) in generated world locations.
teleport.deep_north.help: Nearest Deep North boss / Morkhalla-style location name the world knows.
teleport.queen.help: Nearest Queen / Mistlands dvergr boss location.
camera.hide_hud.help: Hides the game HUD while enabled. The menu stays available.
camera.fov_scale.help: Scales the camera field of view. Takes effect immediately.
camera.max_distance.help: Scales third-person zoom range. Current zoom keeps its relative position.
camera.freecam.help: Detaches the camera using vanilla GameCamera free-fly. Independent of character Flight.
camera.photo_mode.help: Hides HUD chrome; optional freeze. Distinct from freecam but can be combined.
camera.photo_freeze.help: Near-pauses time while Photo mode is on. Restores on exit.
camera.minimap_zoom_control.help: Expands m_minZoom/m_maxZoom and continuously drives m_largeZoom + m_smallZoom from the slider.
camera.minimap_zoom.help: 0.5 = closest in, 2.5 = farthest out (gentler curve / tighter max than 2.5.3).
esp.max_labels.help: Limits label count. Nearby objects take priority.
esp.avoid_overlaps.help: Hides labels that overlap another label.
esp.show_distance.help: Adds the distance beside each name.
esp.text_outline.help: Adds a thin dark outline to improve readability.
esp.label_background.help: Adds a background fitted to each label.
esp.vertical_offset.help: Moves labels above or below objects.
esp.hide_in_menu.help: Hides ESP while you use the menu.
esp.refresh_interval.help: Time between searches for nearby objects.
esp.pin_deposits.help: Adds map markers for nearby ore deposits.
esp.clear_pins.help: Removes ore markers created by this menu.
hotkeys.menu.note: Bind keys to toggles (press flips on/off) and actions (press runs). Works with the menu closed, and while open except when typing or capturing a bind. Conflicts with the menu open key or another feature are rejected.
hotkeys.change_key.help: Click, then press the new menu key. Escape cancels.
hotkeys.bind.help: Click, then press a key. Escape cancels.
toast.hotkey_conflict: Key used by {0}. Clear that bind first.
equipment.unlimited_durability.help: Keeps weapons, tools, and armor repaired.
equipment.inventory_refresh.help: Refreshes the inventory and displayed item values.
equipment.quality.help: m_quality is a 32-bit int. Vanilla stations cap lower; Forge of Potential and this editor can set very high values. Armor/durability scale with quality unless overridden below.
equipment.current_durability.help: Remaining durability, clamped to the maximum when applied.
equipment.stat.help: Enter -1 to use the item's original stat.
equipment.override_damage.help: Uses the entered base damage values for this item.
equipment.damage_field.help: Base damage amount before attack and resistance modifiers.
equipment.save_item.help: Saves the changes on this item or stack.
equipment.restore.warning: Removes this item's stat overrides. Quality is kept.
equipment.quality_whole: Quality must be a whole number.
farming.production_speed.help: Also speeds cooking, fermenting, smelting, and growth on stations you own. 1 is vanilla.
farming.force_grow.help: Finishes nearby plants in the world radius.
farming.world_radius.help: Shared radius for grow, tame, and heal actions.
farming.tame.help: Tames eligible creatures within the radius.
farming.auto_feed.help: Keeps hungry tames fed in range when you own them.
farming.auto_feed_radius.help: Range for auto-feed and breeding helpers.
farming.heal_tames.help: Fully heals tamed creatures in the heal radius.
farming.make_pregnant.help: Starts pregnancy on nearby breedable animals you own. Birth still follows normal timing.
farming.breeding.note: Breeding only works on creatures you own. On co-op, the host usually needs to run this.
items.empty: Catalog is not ready. Try Refresh.
items.select_hint: Choose an item from the list to set its quantity and quality.
items.select_entity_hint: Choose an entity from the list to set its quantity and level.
items.dest.chest.help: Give into accessible nearby chests; prefers stacking.
items.add_inventory.help: Adds the selected item to your inventory.
items.add_chest.help: Adds into nearby chests you can open (prefers existing stacks).
items.drop_ground.help: Drops the item on the ground at the look-hit or at your feet.
items.spawn_entity.help: Spawns the selected entity near your character.
items.spawn_confirm.body: Places the selected entity near your character. It may remain in the saved world.
vfx.reload.help: Refresh the VFX list from the game.
vfx.empty: VFX catalog empty. Enter a world and Reload.
vfx.empty.note1: Search effects by name (particles, one-shots, and FX-style prefabs).
vfx.empty.note2: World spawns and attachments try to sync to other players when the effect supports it; otherwise they stay local.
vfx.clear_last.help: Destroys the most recently spawned world effect.
vfx.clear_all.help: Clears world spawns and all attachments.
vfx.entry.note: World placement is for free-standing spawns. Attach to puts the effect on your character. One-shots replay until duration ends.
vfx.duration.help: 0 = until cleared. Otherwise replays until the timer ends.
vfx.replay_speed.help: How fast one-shots re-trigger and particles play.
vfx.do_effect.help: OFF (default) = visual only (no damage or status areas). ON keeps gameplay effects.
vfx.attach.head: Head
vfx.spawn_attach.help_world: Spawns in the world at World placement.

settings.reload_locales.help: Reloads embedded and disk locale files without restarting the game.
toast.defaults_restored: Defaults restored. Save settings to keep them.

build.inv_override.help: Off: trader inventory upgrades keep working and these sliders do nothing. On: Apply sets this bag size and saves it on the character, so multiplayer keeps it. Equipment and Quick Slots uses it as the visible bag. The game saves at most 9 rows; 10 to 12 are put back on this client.
build.inventory.note_override: Leave Override bag size off to keep bags you bought from traders. Turn it on, set rows or extra columns, then Apply. Chest bonus and stack size are separate. Lowering size may drop items that no longer fit.
build.player_rows.help_override: Used only while Override bag size is on. Vanilla is 4. Store upgrades and dedicated servers stop at 9. This slider allows 12 on your client. With Equipment and Quick Slots this is the visible bag. Press Apply after changing.
build.player_extra_cols.help_override: Used only while Override bag size is on. Adds columns beyond the normal width of 8. Press Apply after changing.
build.capacity_apply.help_override: Applies stack caps now. Bag size is applied only while Override bag size is on. {0}
build.capacity_status_off: Bag follows trader upgrades · chest +{0} rows · stacks {1}
build.paste_level.help: On confirm, flattens loaded terrain under the paste to the lowest piece. Off by default so pastes stay as they are.
build.paste_per_piece.help: While Level ground is on, each bit of ground follows the lowest piece above that spot. Pole tips and floors can sit at different heights. Large blueprints can hitch. Vanilla still cannot move a spot more than 8 m.
build.paste_feather.help: 0 is a hard edge. Higher blends the pad back into the surrounding ground so a raised paste is a slope instead of a cliff.
build.auto_paste_preview.help: When on, loading a blueprint or copying a volume starts a ghost preview that follows your aim. LMB places, P locks, RMB cancels.
build.paste_snap_ground.help: Moves the preview so the lowest piece rests on sampled terrain height. Height slider stays as an offset.
build.paste_anchor_snap.help: While aiming at an existing piece, aligns blueprint snap points to that piece. Overrides ground seat while on.
build.apply_terrain_profile.help: On confirm, applies a terrain height grid from the loaded blueprint (BBP) before placing pieces. Needs terrain ownership.
build.preview_feet.help: Starts a ghost preview at your feet. Aim follow begins unless locked.
build.preview_crosshair.help: Starts a ghost preview at the look-hit. Aim follow begins unless locked.
build.paste_lock.help: Locks the preview in place so you can walk or fly around it. Press again to resume aim follow. Default hotkey P.
build.paste_height.help: Vertical offset for the active paste preview.
build.paste_pitch.help: Pitch of the paste preview. Shift+scroll also adjusts while aiming.
build.paste_yaw.help: Yaw of the paste preview. Scroll adjusts while aiming.
build.paste_roll.help: Roll of the paste preview. Alt+scroll also adjusts while aiming.
build.paste_nudge_x.help: Horizontal nudge left/right in preview space.
build.paste_nudge_z.help: Horizontal nudge forward/back in preview space.
build.confirm_paste.help: Places the clipboard at the preview position. LMB does the same while preview is active.
build.cancel_preview.help: Clears the paste ghost without placing. Clipboard stays loaded.
build.free_rotation.help: Rotate placement ghosts on X/Y/Z. Scroll yaw, Shift+scroll pitch, Alt+scroll roll. V resets the active axis.
build.universal_snap.help: Aligns any placing piece to nearby snap points, including mixed materials (stone to wood, etc.). Also used with free rotation.
build.free_rotation_local.help: Rotate around the piece local axes instead of world axes.
build.rotation_divisions.help: Divisions per 180 degrees. Default 45 is about 4 degrees per step. Raise toward 180 for finer control.
build.free_rotation.note: While free rotation is on, RGB axes draw on the placement ghost. Paste preview uses the same scroll modifiers.
build.hud_enabled.help: Semi-transparent corner panel while placing or pasting.
build.drag_enabled.help: Hold place on walls, floors, or beams. Starts snapped to the piece under the ghost, then steps along that snap axis. Release to place. RMB cancels.
build.drag_max.help: Hard cap for one drag stroke.
build.blueprints.note: Saved across worlds and characters. Import .vbp, PlanBuild .blueprint, or BetterBuilding .bbp. Export writes .vbp.
build.load_clipboard.help: Loads the blueprint into the clipboard. Auto paste preview starts a ghost if enabled.
build.paste_feet.help: Loads the blueprint and places immediately at your feet (skips auto preview).
build.import_path.help: File name under blueprints/, or a full path to .vbp / .bbp / .blueprint.
build.import.help: Adds the file to your library. Same names overwrite.
build.hammer_all_prefabs.help: Adds most Valheim prefabs to the hammer menu (pickables, creatures, vegetation, props), like Better Creative. Free to place. Already-vanilla hammer pieces stay in their normal tabs.
build.hammer_all_prefabs.note: Catalog ready: {0} prefabs. Equip the hammer and open build categories Pickable, NPCs, Vegetation, and others.
build.hammer_all_prefabs.off: Turn on to load the full hammer catalog (can hitch once).
build.hammer_catalog.help: Reload every networked prefab into the hammer menu for this session.
build.hammer_creature_ai.help: On: hammer-spawned creatures hunt and fight like natural spawns. Off: they stay put with idle animations only (statue / mannequin).
build.level_on_place.help: While on, each piece you place with the hammer levels the loaded ground under that piece, down to its underside. Poles and floors can sit at different heights. Vanilla still cannot move a spot more than 8 m.
build.level_on_place.feather: Slope around the placed piece. 0 is a hard edge. This is the same Feather edge used by blueprint paste.
world.level_last_paste.help: Flattens the last confirmed paste footprint. Hard edge.
world.feather_last_paste.help: Re-levels the last paste footprint and blends the edge using Feather edge.
camera.freecam_build.help: Moves your character with the free-fly camera, noclip on, no fall damage. Hammer, chests, and other interactions use that spot. Other players see you move. Turning this off leaves you where the camera stopped.
combat.melee_lock.help: Locks a target inside your current melee reach and turns you toward them when you swing. Does not add range or extra hits.
combat.melee_lock_players.help: Allow melee target lock to pick other players. Off by default.
character.flying_mount.help: While riding a saddle, Jump climbs and Crouch descends. Gravity returns when you dismount or turn this off. Use Dismount to get off while flying, because Crouch is down.
character.mount_any.help: Look at a creature and Mount. Saddled animals skip the tame requirement. Creatures without a saddle get a seat on their back. Movement keys steer them.
character.mount_next.help: Arms one mount. Close the menu and look at a creature for a moment. It mounts, then this turns off. Works with Mount any creature.
character.mount_next.armed: Mount armed. Close the menu and look at a creature.
character.mount_look.help: Mount the creature under the crosshair. Without a saddle this needs Mount any creature.
character.dismount.help: Leaves a saddle or a mounted creature.
ui.choose_what_to_hide_applies: Choose what to hide. Applies to all star levels.
ui.hide_this_type_including_starred: Hide this type, including starred creatures.
ui.no_matching_entries_enter_a: No matching entries. Enter a world to load the catalog.
ui.no_location_response_try_another: No location response. Try another destination.
ui.teleported_to_a_loaded_forge: Teleported to a loaded Forge of Potential station.
ui.select_an_item_to_configure: Select an item to configure its spawn preset.
ui.explicit_overrides_stay_fixed_vanilla: Explicit overrides stay fixed. Vanilla stats scale with quality. Combat modifiers still apply.
ui.blank_vanilla_overrides_0_to: Blank = Vanilla. Overrides: 0 to 99,999. Weight is per item; backstab is a multiplier.
ui.force_equip_the_selected_item: Force-equip the selected item into a visible slot. Other players will see it. No stats are changed.
ui.ignore_key_requirements_for_sunken: Ignore key requirements for Sunken Crypts, Queen's door, etc.
ui.makes_the_water_surface_solid: Makes the water surface solid beneath you.
ui.tries_to_mount_the_closest: Tries to mount the closest saddle within 40 m.
ui.forces_a_creature_to_always: Forces a creature to always drop its trophy when defeated, bypassing vanilla drop chances.
ui.how_many_trophies_to_force: How many trophies to force drop when Force trophy drops is enabled.
ui.overrides_world_settings_and_mods: Overrides world settings and mods that disable the map.
ui.marks_the_nearest_altar_for: Marks the nearest altar for each boss with its proper name.
ui.marks_haldor_hildir_and_the: Marks Haldor, Hildir, and the Bog Witch by name.
ui.marks_the_nearest_generated_forge: Marks the nearest generated Forge of Potential.
ui.locally_lights_up_dark_areas: Locally lights up dark areas like dungeons and nights.
ui.prevents_random_events_base_raids: Prevents random events (base raids) from triggering automatically.
ui.join_a_world_to_see: Join a world to see and trigger events.
ui.plant_crops_trees_and_decorations: Plant crops, trees, and decorations for free with your cultivator.
ui.your_plants_stay_when_turned: Your plants stay when turned off. You can only remove plants you placed.
ui.reload_the_plants_available_in: Reload the plants available in this world.
ui.equipped_guardian_power_applied_to: Equipped Guardian Power applied to the local player.
ui.full_map_explored_and_staged: Full map explored and staged in character map data. This action has no automatic undo.
ui.ui_closed_after_a_rendering: UI closed after a rendering error. See Valheaven.log.
ui.command_queue_is_full_wait: Command queue is full. Wait for pending actions.
ui.large_clipboard_paste_can_hitch: Large clipboard - paste can hitch peers/host. Prefer smaller volumes or save as blueprint first.
ui.no_nearby_owned_tombstone_to: No nearby owned tombstone to reclaim.
